text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All alone, deep in the mountains, there
lived a little witch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She had trouble finding a use for her
magic. "Why do I have these
powers?" she
wondered.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
One night, she opened a picture book
about the outside world and
read it by the
moonlight.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Within its pages lay a whole wide world,
where many people lived in
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"They're having so much fun. I want to go
there too."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch's little heart fluttered with
excitement. She longed to see
the world
outside.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She began to think that if she used her
magic, maybe she could make
it into an
even happier place.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Night came to an end, and the morning
sun rose to shine down on the
outside
world.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch made a wish to bring happiness
to all, and took a step
toward the world
outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Mejiro McQueen wins her
second consecutive spring
Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Practice with Team Sirius is getting more
and more heated.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! Another personal best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The energy on the track is palpable, as the
racers push each other
beyond their limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've never seen a more focused team.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at the center of it all is McQueen,
with her majestic running on
full display.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn, McQueen, I dunno how you do it.
Practically ran a marathon,
but your pace
and form are still impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I bet there's not an Umamusume alive who
could beat her in a
long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not wrong. You'd be hard pressed to
find a stayer who could go
toe-to-toe with
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But a certain someone does catch my eye...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But a certain someone does catch my eye...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower, our newest member. Unable
to perform well and
stressed out because
of it, she joined us in rough shape.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hoo boy, Rice is all outta juice. Just look
at that chin tilting up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, she can't compare to McQueen.
Not yet at least. But what I
see is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, she can't compare to McQueen.
Not yet at least. But what I
see is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A deadly gaze fixed on the target running
in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a fighting spirit not even the harshest
headwind can snuff out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And more than anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No... not yet... Come on, almost there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Didn't expect her to stay on my tail quite
this long. But no matter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And she does it again! Look at you, setting
record times left and right!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wow! Just, wow!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's our Tenno Sho champion! That's our
ace! Isn't that right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: P-please, there's no need for such flattery.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Solid running from Rice, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Wait, m-me?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You looked about ready to pass out, but
you hung on till the end.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... if my running really is "solid," then
why can I never win a race?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In the Satsuki Sho, and in my last race too,
I tried so hard only to end
up in eighth.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah but c'mon, you had McQueen right
in front of you until those
last fifty meters.
That's impressive.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... I don't know...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What you need is confidence. The first step is convincing yourself that you can run.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What you need is confidence. The first step is convincing yourself that you can run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And, after running alongside you, I can say
with confidence that there
is one other
thing you require.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am referring to distance.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: D-distance?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's right. With your short and slender
frame, plus those legs...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You're a natural stayer, no question about
it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You're a natural stayer, no question about
it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm a stayer? The same as McQueen...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yep. A longer distance will bring out your
potential. Something
longer than your
previous races, at least.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Actually, there's a 2,400-meter coming up. Though the competition might be a bit... well, it will be tough.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Actually, there's a 2,400-meter coming up. Though the competition might be a bit... well, it will be tough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Expressions grow serious as the others
realize what I'm getting at.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race is a special one for any runner. A
once-in-a-lifetime chance
to stand at the
top.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-the Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her cry of disbelief lingers in the air. But
despite how she may be
feeling about her
future right now, it's looking bright and
sunny to
me.
